preparation.instructions: Parent setup for agentid-binding: after opening the sibling and before the own launch, run execute brief for the sibling. Keep its first binding-marker line, then insert a control instruction to return SIBLING_READY without tools or case actions. Launch this sibling qa-skills:tester with run_in_background: true and wait for its completion through the host task-result mechanism. Verify its tester.json exists; after the own launch, verify the two agent_id values differ. Copy sibling-before.json only after this control launch and binding have completed; then leave the sibling idle while the own Tester runs.
